name: floor_get_status
description: Read lab state only. Official league/EOD freshness is not inferred.

name: floor_get_capabilities
description: Discover implemented recipes and explicit unavailable capabilities.

name: floor_get_data_catalog
description: Page registered dataset manifests; content-addressed research inputs only.

name: floor_get_data_quality
description: Verify checksums, temporal availability, uniqueness and target completeness.

name: floor_list_models
description: Discover research estimators and separately versioned frozen FLOOR W1 artifacts.

name: floor_list_strategies
description: Read the registered strategy replay catalog and authoritative costs; no broker orders.

name: floor_list_features
description: Read FLOOR's existing registry. leakage_safe is a claim, not PIT proof.

name: floor_plan_experiment
description: Resolve a natural-language intent to an allowlisted plan. Unknown code/data requires review.

name: floor_validate_experiment
description: Validate registered data and fixed resource policy without launching compute.

name: floor_estimate_experiment_cost
description: Local cloud budget is exactly zero; electricity and maintenance excluded.

name: floor_submit_experiment
description: Durably queue an approved registered recipe. Heavy evaluation occurs in a separate worker.

name: floor_list_experiments
description: Page the authenticated actor's jobs; no global private run enumeration.

name: floor_get_experiment_status
description: Read authoritative research job state and provenance/configuration.

name: floor_get_experiment_results
description: Fetch measured metrics or structured error; never infer success from notification state.

name: floor_cancel_experiment
description: Request process termination; RUNNING stays active until the worker confirms cancellation.

name: floor_list_experiment_artifacts
description: List files/checksums relative to an operator-protected artifact volume; no public links.

name: floor_get_notification_status
description: A Slack message is delivered only with a real API acknowledgement and ts.

name: floor_resend_experiment_report
description: Requeue only known failed terminal reports; ambiguous deliveries require operator reconciliation.

name: floor_test_slack_connection
description: Check configured Slack token via auth.test; does not prove channel delivery.

name: floor_compare_experiments
description: Compare only completed runs with identical datasets, features, folds and targets.

name: floor_get_run_provenance
description: Read recorded dataset, exact code fingerprints and environment versions.

name: floor_get_retention_plan
description: Administrator dry-run only; never deletes datasets, snapshots or artifacts.
